dimensions.note: No credential fields; command failure context is bounded and credential-redacted.
status, start, and stop have no entry or completion logging.
Command, certificate, timeout, and validation failures throw before status persistence.
Tests cover lifecycle success/failure, strict config, abort bounds, certificate errors, hung children, output flooding, and redaction.
Configured supervisor commands are explicitly required to be idempotent; status uses one stable instance.
Only configurable loopback health HTTP is allowed; no external provider API.
Subprocess duration/output are bounded; timed-out process groups are terminated and streams settled.
Published configuration uses loopback and generic supervisor examples.
Global arguments, nested config, method arguments, and status output are strict.
status declares infinite lifetime and garbageCollection 10.
Local lifecycle surface provides start, stop, and status operations.
start and stop execute configured commands without labeled Swamp pre-flight checks.
All methods write the same complete StatusSchema to status-current.
Methods observe the local process directly and do not read stored Swamp state.
Initial standalone publication; no prior published model version.
